messages:
Nora_PM: Quick sync — need to finalize launch criteria for the routing-policy inheritance work. Customer asks: per-tenant overlays vs strict global guardrails. Can we agree on precedence and gating today?
chao_infra: my preference: explicit precedence matrix: tenant > region > fleet/global. keeps overrides local but still enforces minimum SLOs.
chao_infra: we also need a staged enforcement mode (log-only -> warn -> enforce) so customers can opt-in to fixes.
tim_r: +1 on staged enforcement. also want telemetry hooks: delta on p95 latency and model-quality regressions (prompted by evals). We should block enforce if quality delta > X.
tim_r: proposal: canary rollout by tenant percent (0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) + automated rollback if p95 increases > 15ms or eval score drops > 3 pts.
olivia_prod: For product/customer gating: require 2 pilot customers with opt-in and success metrics for 2 weeks before full GA. Also need a clear internal checklist: docs, migration notes, runbook.
maya: we also need a migration tool to translate existing route rules into the new precedence model. Otherwise ops will be manually editing hundreds of route objects. 
maya: rough plan: 1) dry-run translator (produces report), 2) apply-in-staging, 3) validate via synthetic traffic.
chao_infra: example of the precedence YAML we expect teams to author:
```yaml
policy_precedence:
  - level: tenant
    keys: [route_overrides, kv_cache_policy]
  - level: region
    keys: [egress_controls, failover_priority]
  - level: global
    keys: [min_slo, allowed_model_classes]
```
chao_infra: note: enforcement will always merge keys, but if a tenant sets a lower-than-min_slo we reject at validation.
Nora_PM: Good. Can we convert that into launch criteria bullets? I'll draft and tag owners.
tim_r: Suggested launch criteria (short):
- Policy engine deployed (staged modes support)
- Precedence translator available in dry-run
- Canary automation wired to rollout service
- Telemetry: p95 latency + eval-run integration active
- 2 pilot customers signed and monitoring green for 14 days
- Runbook for rollback and manual evacuation tested
olivia_prod: add: docs + sample tenant overlays + support playbook. Also legal check for data residency interactions.
maya: Ops tasks: DB migration plan for route metadata (non-blocking if translator exists), and an idempotent apply script.
chao_infra: I'll own the precedence validator + staged enforcement flags. Tim, can infra own canary automation?
tim_r: Yup, infra will own canary automation and the rollback hooks. I'll coordinate with infra-sre for the traffic split primitives.
Nora_PM: OK — owners: @chao_infra validator/staged enforcement; @tim_r canary/rollback; @maya migration tooling; @olivia_prod pilot onboarding + docs. I'll schedule a 30m handoff this afternoon.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout job started for routing-policy-precedence v1 -> 0.5% traffic (job id: canary-1798880001-1) :rocket:
chao_infra: thanks. once the canary completes we'll surface telemetry in the console dashboard (route-level p95 / eval-summaries).
Nora_PM: Awesome. If anyone has redlines or blockers please DM me before 4pm, otherwise we'll proceed with the staged plan. :white_check_mark:
